model: Codex CLI default, no model override; exact backend identifier not emitted in JSONL.
sampling: One fresh Codex CLI session per case. Eight candidate poetry cases rerun. Three historical baseline conditions reused by reference, not rerun. A diagnostic sample, not a statistical comparison.
capabilities: Local files, Python and Node only; no network, browser, live host APIs, installs, publishing or global fonts.
grading: Lead semantic review against the unchanged frozen rubric, condition known. See grades.json for criterion-level evidence. Software success is not a literary-quality grade.
